parsed.name: NI-DAQmx任务定时配置组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于配置 NI-DAQmx 数据采集任务的定时参数。它管理采样时钟、模数转换时钟、参考时钟、握手定时、同步脉冲和变更检测等设置，供 DAQ 任务进行采集或输出时使用。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for configuring timing parameters of NI-DAQmx data acquisition tasks. It manages sample clocks, AI convert clocks, reference clocks, handshaking timing, synchronization pulses, and change-detection settings for DAQ acquisition or generation tasks.
